name: AJAX Product Filter for WooCommerce
author: webangon

sections.description:
AJAX Product Filter for WooCommerce helps shoppers narrow a catalog down to what they want in a few clicks. Each change refreshes the product grid instantly, and every option shows a live count of matching products, so nobody lands on an empty page.

Filters are built in a visual builder with a live preview that uses your real products. Pick a preset, add or reorder filters, choose a skin and layout, and place the filter on your shop. No code is needed.

Filter by anything shoppers care about

  • Categories, tags and brands as checkboxes, radio buttons, chips or dropdowns
  • Product attributes such as colour and size, including colour and image swatches
  • Price range slider with min and max inputs, or preset price ranges
  • Average rating (4 stars and up, 3 stars and up…)
  • Stock status (in stock, on backorder, out of stock)
  • On sale toggle
  • Sort order (popularity, rating, newest, price)
  • Active filters chips with one-click remove and “Clear all”

Layouts and design

  • Vertical sidebar, accordion, horizontal bar with dropdown panels, or a popup opened from a Filters button
  • Mobile-friendly: a slide-in drawer on small screens, and the popup becomes a bottom sheet on phones
  • Six skins (classic, cards, minimal, soft, outline, dark) with your own colours, radius, spacing and font sizes
  • Ready-made presets: shop sidebar, horizontal bar, card accordion, dark compact and popup filter

Fast AJAX shop experience

  • The product grid, result count and pagination update without reloading the page
  • Option counts refresh in a single lightweight request, so it stays fast on large catalogs
  • Update results instantly or wait for an “Apply” button
  • AJAX pagination: page numbers, previous and next, “Load more” button or infinite scroll
  • Filtered URLs are shareable and bookmarkable, and the back button works
  • Works without JavaScript as a normal form, which is good for accessibility and SEO

Place filters anywhere

  • Automatically beside the shop and product category, tag and brand archives, with an optional sticky sidebar
  • Shortcode: [webangon_product_filter id="123"]
  • Gutenberg block
  • Elementor widget (Webangon category)
  • Classic widget for classic theme sidebars

Privacy

The plugin does not connect to any external service and does not track visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the webangon-product-filter folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to Products > Product Filters, create a filter set and choose where it appears.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. Add the “Product Filter” widget from the Webangon category and choose a filter set. Put it on a shop or product archive template so it can refresh the product grid.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 8.0 or newer is required.

Can I show a filter set anywhere?

Yes. Use the shortcode, block, classic widget or Elementor widget shown on the filter set edit screen.
